author: telthetruth
body:
A good T10 Carl’s Ring would probably do you better than the serpent pearl. I’d also swap out the briny pendant for a Ymir vritra charm, and depend on panacea to cure toxic.

Ditch the Atlas shield first chance you get, Ymir coiled shield, arisen shield, or chained spiked shield all have either better ward or comparable ward with more utility.

If you haven’t demonforged because you’re waiting on higher quality equipment, that’s probably for the best if you’re short on materials, but go ahead and demonforge if you can afford the materials, especially for that fey surtr cuirass. Demonforged items have a small chance to become godforged when you defeat opponents with a gold aura - like all of the dragons during the current event. Godforging gives another level to equipment stats and also opens up another adorn slot.

author: Desperate-Grand4905
body: My go to ursa build for raids is a beguiled Y helm, beastfelled cuirass and pumpkinless legs, all with crimson pinions in, with an arisen labrys for weapon full of sand mortars, and 2 arisen trev charms, its a full collateral damage build that uses strikes of ursa as the main dmg source or GS4 or X slash if u want a 1 turn skill, iirc i was hitting for about 9m fully buffed with swash spec, only 15 AL’s
